_doc: emerald_caves 2026-10-12: Emerald's MagmaHideout_3F_1R (pokeemerald) read as Emerald's world reads it (models_cave 'emerald/<Map>'); void = walkable tiles no warp reaches, pools = its blocked water; its lava (blocked lava metatiles) drawn as Black 2's Reversal Mountain lava (Ruby's Cave of Origin recipe); emerald_polish_caves 2026-10-12: void also the top half of each door (MB_ANIMATED_DOOR 0x60 in Lavaridge's tileset is two tiles tall: Gen 3 marks the upper tile walkable but nobody reaches it; drawn as floor, the door's arch opened into a black floor square)
